title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression checks and CI gating for quality metrics
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Prevent prompt-set regressions from being merged to main by adding a blocking CI gate that runs the eval-harness against curated prompt sets and enforces quality thresholds. This PR adds a GitHub Actions job (eval-gate) which spins up the eval-harness docker image, runs configured prompt suites, computes per-prompt metrics (exact_match, f1, rouge_l, hallucination_rate) and compares them against the baseline thresholds stored in /eval-harness/quality-metrics.yaml. If any metric regresses beyond configured tolerances the job fails and posts a summary comment. The change also wires the gate into protected-branch rules and adds a brief dashboard query for the Console. What changed: - New CI workflow .github/workflows/eval-gate.yaml implementing the eval-gate job and summary commenter. - Eval harness integration code under eval-harness/ci_runner.py to run suites, aggregate metrics, and produce JSON summaries compatible with the existing gating library. - Configuration file eval-harness/quality-metrics.yaml with per-prompt tolerances and baseline hashes. - Small test harness under eval-harness/tests/test_ci_runner.py with mocked model responses to validate gating logic. - Docs update in docs/eval/ci-gates.md explaining how to add prompt sets and update baselines. - Makefile target make eval-ci-image to build the container used in CI. Checklist: - [x] Implement CI workflow and runner - [x] Add baseline metrics file and sample prompt-suite - [x] Tests for gating logic - [x] Docs and onboarding notes - [x] Add reviewers and run CI Remarks: The description includes the gating behavior: by default thresholds are conservative (0.5% absolute drop allowed on high-sensitivity metrics, 2% on lower-sensitivity metrics). Baseline updates require a Linear proposal and an explicit ./eval-harness/update_baseline --accept where the user provides a Linear key. Related: ENG-1243 (add prompt regression protection), ENG-1304 (eval-harness metrics plumbing).

release_notes: Add CI gating for eval-harness: runs prompt-set regression checks and blocks merges when quality metrics regress beyond configured tolerances. See docs/eval/ci-gates.md for usage and baseline update process.
notes: This PR adds infra to block regressions but intentionally keeps thresholds conservative. Teams should propose baseline updates via Linear when intentionally accepting metric shifts.
example_ci_comment: Eval-gate summary: 1 prompt-suite run. Metrics: exact_match: baseline 0.823 -> current 0.816 (delta -0.7% => BELOW threshold), rouge_l: baseline 0.721 -> 0.719 (within threshold). Result: FAILED on exact_match. To accept new baseline run ./eval-harness/update_baseline --accept --linear ENG-XXXX and add the updated quality-metrics.yaml to the PR.
testing_notes: Unit tests mock model outputs and validate gating behavior; integration smoke suite runs a lightweight public model in CI. Observed median runtime ~6m for smoke suite; full suites run in ~12-15m in CI depending on cache hit.
